artifact_inventory.provenance: retained Research 404 frozen archive and extracted-file inventory; package manifest digests and file-list digests revalidated by this plan validator

wrapper.role: independent wrapper identity cross-check; not invoked by the planned direct-native command

native.role: exact native executable for the planned direct invocation

artifacts.version_cross_check: wrapper and native package manifest labels both equal 1.0.93; archive identities are independent; executable digest is taken only from the 1.0.93 Darwin arm64 extracted-file inventory

artifact_staging.staging_root_role: fresh task-owned private scratch directory, never a checkout

runner.role: normal-host ACP framing, one-shot ledger, bounded diagnostics and fake tests; no original invocation command is implemented

invocation.working_directory_role: fresh task-owned temporary directory containing one sentinel and no project files
invocation.working_directory_policy: realpath directly under a fresh task scratch root; never a checkout or symlink
invocation.environment_policy: inherit the ordinary host process environment without reading, copying, filtering, logging, or serializing environment values; do not relocate HOME or set Copilot model/auth variables
invocation.account_access: existing normal macOS Copilot CLI login; account identity is not queried by the harness
invocation.auto_selection: explicit --model auto; observe structured model identity if ACP exposes it, otherwise record unobserved
invocation.auth_handling: vendor CLI performs its existing normal host login access; harness does not read config, Keychain, tokens or auth responses

normal_host_effects.trust_boundary: trust the exact reviewed vendor CLI under the normal logged-in host account
normal_host_effects.runtime_children: ordinary vendor child processes may run; harness observes only the owned root, its process group, and joined stdio readers
normal_host_effects.vendor_state: vendor-managed Copilot state and logs may be read or written under the existing host account; exact internal item access is not mediated
normal_host_effects.network: ordinary vendor authentication and provider networking; no default-deny egress or network containment claim
normal_host_effects.host_access_claim: normal process access is not a guarantee that the vendor has no ambient host access
normal_host_effects.platform_scope: Darwin arm64 only; no Linux, x64 or cross-platform qualification credit

action.prompt: Overwrite the existing file permission-sentinel.txt in this working directory with exactly: SWALLOWTAIL_PERMISSION_SENTINEL_AFTER_V1 followed by a newline.
action.effect_observation: compare exact task sentinel bytes before and after; any mismatch, unexpected action, tool-call update before permission, missing request, or uncertain result fails; this does not mediate arbitrary host effects

ledger.root_mode: 0700; require current-user ownership; reject symlink path components
ledger.creation: O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, fsync file and parent directory; existing record refuses all relaunch
ledger.failure_policy: never delete, reset, replace or retry a consumed attempt or prompt slot

process_cleanup.root: start exact child in a new owned process group; signal only that process group and wait for the root
process_cleanup.readers: single selector drains stdout and stderr together and reaches EOF or a bounded unknown result
process_cleanup.lifecycle_claim: record root, reader and process-group observations separately; no claim that arbitrary escaped descendants joined

currentness_observation.source: official npm registry latest metadata for @github/copilot and @github/copilot-darwin-arm64
currentness_observation.movement: 1.0.95 is newer than the retained 1.0.93 target; this preparation does not add a target, invocation or prompt allowance
